reading_log.notes: Read complete introduction, pipeline, related work and probabilistic-method background; separate evaluated maximum clique/local constrained min-cut from illustrative MaxCut.
Read general Bernoulli set formulation, nonnegative penalty certificate with beta bound, box rescaling/probability theorem, conditional-expectation decoder and clique/constrained-cut specializations.

Read cut corollary, methods/data/protocol and all Tables 1-3 entries. Record Gurobi/greedy and RUN-CSP counterexamples, per-graph seconds, reduction costs, partial overfit and larger-instance degradation, and conductance versus cut objective.
Read entire broader-impact section, acknowledgements and all references 1-87; distinguish exact cited versions and restrict later links to catalogue titles with explicit in-text citation.

Read official ZIP supplement visual example, all dataset statistics, task-specific architectures (clique omits GAT), exact local-cut seed protocol and corrective footnote, hardware, models and all constraint-violation/learning ablations.

Read all Gurobi/local-cut budget tables and setup costs; complete penalty theorem, scaling and box proofs, clique derivation and beginning cut proof. Checked low-loss nonnegative/penalty assumptions and distinction between deterministic certificate and unrestricted sampling claim.

Read complete constrained-cut derivation and all separately numbered supplement references 1-83. Supplement uses draft line/page/reference numbering, so citation labels will be sourced from final main bibliography.
